sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful: it targets the supplied ship owner, recognizes both verified qualifying ice conditions, excludes those conditions in the non-applicable branch, permits category A as the exception, and requires exactly category B for qualifying non-A ships. Deterministic validation is valid and no canonical vocabulary repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the applicability logic: the requirement applies to ships designed for operation in at least thin first-year ice with possible old-ice inclusions, not only to the exact thin condition. Include the supplied mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions value (and any other verified qualifying controlled values) in the qualifying branch, require category B there when the category is not A, and make the non-applicable branch exclude all qualifying values. Require at least one shipCategory there and enforce the conditional result faithfully: category A is the exception, while any non-A qualifying ship must have shipCategory exactly polarShipCategoryB. Keep all properties targeted on the supplied ship owner.

The candidate is semantically faithful: it targets the supplied ship owner, recognizes both verified qualifying ice conditions, excludes those conditions in the non-applicable branch, permits category A as the exception, and requires exactly category B for qualifying non-A ships. Deterministic validation is valid and no canonical vocabulary repair is required.
